text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her first three years in the Twinkle 
Series behind her, Royce and Royce—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's how you avoid overlapping 
character tropes. It's the foundation of 
self-branding.”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you check the materials I gave 
you for Umamusume who might become your 
peers.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student A
text_block_list.text: "Let's see... 'Ponytail percentage'?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I looked into how many ponytail 
Umamusume there are across each 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If lots of girls in your generation have 
ponytails, it's better to choose a 
different hairstyle.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student B
text_block_list.text:
This document here is... the "Umamusume 
with Musical Talents Matrix"...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know there were other Umamusume 
besides me who loved music this much.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Because Earth-san overlaps with Kita-san 
on the point of "starting to perform 
anywhere."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"You have to be careful when you start 
playing together so they don't end up 
stealing the spotlight from you."

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student A
text_block_list.text:
"To think you looked into all of this... 
Self-producing really is tough work...!"

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student B
text_block_list.text:
"I don't feel like I can ever catch up at 
all... But still, I don't wanna end up a 
nobody! I look forward to your continued 
guidance!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes, see you next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce was lecturing the 
Umamusume who looked up to her on the art 
of self-promotion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They are all Umamusume of average ability. 
That is precisely why they saw hope in the 
"ultimate strength" she strives for.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—So then, Royce-san. Today we're 
reviewing the concert stage direction, 
right?”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The six of us are going to sing a 
song together at the upcoming event live, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So I thought maybe we could do group 
performances and fan service.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, if we don't go that far, it 
won't leave an impression at all!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The ones before us are Teio and those 
other sparkling Umamusume, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, let's go crash Teio 
and the others' party!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, a battle of the bands? I think 
that's a great idea."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: A battle of the bands? How exciting!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A battle of the bands... A clash between 
groups, is it? —That sounds fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that's reckless! You'll just end 
up getting swallowed by all the glitter...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, if it's a joint gig, it's fine. In 
fact, by riding on Teio and the others' 
popularity, we can stand out too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, is that so! In that case, wouldn't a 
battle of the bands be even better!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: This is the decisive moment, Nature-san!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ah~ geez!! Guess I've got no choice~!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And so, we ended up challenging Teio-san 
and the others to a battle of the bands.
choice_data_list:
Alright, time for a direct showdown with 
Teio.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh? —No, that's not it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No way... But, we might never get another 
chance like this...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Not just in races, but in 
Winning Lives too! We must have the drive 
to surpass her!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"What I aim for is to become the 
'strongest' with her in the field."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I won't flinch! Not until I reach the 
heights of the 'strongest'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The journey is still long. Yet, step by 
step, we are steadily drawing closer—
